steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.31 | PATCH | Ensure 'UPnP Device Host (upnphost)' is set to 'Disabled'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_31
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.31
    - upnphost
  block:
    - name: "5.31 | AUDIT | Ensure 'UPnP Device Host (upnphost)' is set to 'Disabled' | Check to see if upnphost service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: upnphost
      register: discovered_5_31_upnphost_service_info

    - name: "5.31 | PATCH | Ensure 'UPnP Device Host (upnphost)' is set to 'Disabled' | Disable upnphost service"
      when: discovered_5_31_upnphost_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: upnphost
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
